headline: Administrative Officer

skill_groups.label: Public administration
items: regulatory compliance with civil service and audit rules

summary: Administrative officer with five years in a regional development authority in Eastern Samar. I run the executive office's administration, implement new policies and programs, keep public records compliant with civil service and audit rules, and support the general manager in daily decisions.

experience.title: Administrative Officer IV
experience.employer: Eastern Samar Pacific Coast Development Authority
bullets: Run the office of the general manager: calendar, correspondence, board papers and follow-ups.
Roll out new policies and office procedures to 60 employees and track compliance.
Keep records and archives in line with records-retention and audit requirements.
Prepare briefing notes and policy options for management and the board.

experience.title: Administrative Officer II
experience.employer: Eastern Samar Pacific Coast Development Authority
bullets: Processed travel, leave and procurement documents for the operations division.
Maintained the incoming and outgoing communications log.
